_README: Template for a new tool catalog.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS:
The tool-generation prompts ground hard on each tool's `description`,
`parameters` types, and `examples[]`. Thin catalogs produce hallucinated
training data regardless of how good the teacher model is.
Copy this file, rename to <topic>_tools.json, fill in real tools, and
validate with `generator tool-lint configs/tools/<topic>_tools.json`
before kicking off a generation run.
CHECKLIST PER TOOL:
[ ] description: 1-3 sentences. NAME the actual return keys.
Mention when the tool fails (404/422/etc.) and what it raises.
[ ] parameters: each one has `type` from
{string, integer, number, boolean, array, object}.
[ ] parameters: description >= 5 chars and explains the expected value
shape (not just the field name re-worded).
[ ] examples: at least 2 — one common case, one edge/error case.
[ ] examples[].input: valid JSON string (escape quotes).
[ ] examples[].output: valid JSON OR a labelled error string
('404: foo not found', 'ToolError: ...', '500: ...').
Use REAL values (curl the live API once, paste shapes here).
[ ] returns: type + description explaining the wrapper shape.
[ ] category: groups related tools (used by tool-deps and curation).
DELETE this `_README` key when you fork — the parser ignores it but it
shouldn't ship into a real catalog.
name: <TOPIC> Tools
description: Short paragraph describing the tool surface. Backend URL or repo path. Date the examples were captured.

tools.name: <verb>_<noun>
tools.description: Natural-language description of WHAT the tool does and WHAT IT RETURNS. Name the actual return keys here (e.g. 'Returns {id, status, created_at}'). Mention failure modes ('Raises ToolError if id not found').

parameters.name: primary_id
parameters.description: The identifier to act on. Format: <describe format, e.g. UUID, slug, hex string>.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of tag strings to filter by (any-match semantics).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Free-form options dict accepted by the backend.

returns.description: Object with the result fields. Name them here so the LLM doesn't invent new keys.

examples.instruction: REAL natural-language user request that maps to this tool. Avoid 'foo', 'bar', 'test'.
Edge case — the user passes an identifier that doesn't exist on the backend.
examples.output: ToolError: <thing> not found with id: definitely-not-real-00000000
